tools.name: woodpecker_list_campaigns
tools.description: List cold email campaigns with their status (RUNNING, DRAFT, EDITED, PAUSED, STOPPED, COMPLETED). Filter by status or ids. Woodpecker API: GET /rest/v1/campaign_list.

tools.name: woodpecker_get_campaign
tools.description: Get one campaign with its detailed information and statistics (sent, opened, replied, bounced). Woodpecker API: GET /rest/v1/campaign_list?id={id}.

tools.name: woodpecker_list_prospects
tools.description: List prospects across the account with their global status (ACTIVE, BOUNCED, REPLIED, BLACKLIST, INVALID). Woodpecker API: GET /rest/v1/prospects.

tools.name: woodpecker_list_campaign_prospects
tools.description: List the prospects enrolled in one or more campaigns, with their status and replies inside those campaigns. Woodpecker API: GET /rest/v1/prospects?campaigns_id=.

tools.name: woodpecker_search_prospects
tools.description: Find prospects by field, for example email=jane@acme.com or company=Acme. Set campaigns_details to also get the campaigns each prospect belongs to. Woodpecker API: GET /rest/v1/prospects?search=.

tools.name: woodpecker_get_prospect_responses
tools.description: Get the replies one prospect sent, optionally only for some campaigns. Woodpecker API: GET /rest/v2/prospects/{prospect_id}/responses.

tools.name: woodpecker_list_inbox_messages
tools.description: List replies in the unified inbox, filterable by campaign, mailbox, prospect status or interest, and read state. Paginated with cursors (max 50 per page). Woodpecker API: GET /rest/v2/inbox/messages.

tools.name: woodpecker_list_mailboxes
tools.description: List the connected sending mailboxes (SMTP and IMAP) with provider, daily limit and sent_today. Woodpecker API: GET /rest/v2/mailboxes.

tools.name: woodpecker_get_mailbox
tools.description: Get one mailbox by id: email, provider, daily limit, sent_today and sending delay. Woodpecker API: GET /rest/v2/mailboxes/{id}.

tools.name: woodpecker_list_manual_tasks
tools.description: List manual tasks (follow-ups a person should do by hand, such as a call or LinkedIn step). Woodpecker API: GET /rest/v2/manual_tasks.

tools.name: woodpecker_list_users
tools.description: List the users of the Woodpecker account with their role (admin or user). Woodpecker API: GET /rest/v2/users.

tools.name: woodpecker_list_blacklisted_domains
tools.description: List blacklisted domains (never contacted again). Use domain_filter to check specific domains; * is a wildcard. Woodpecker API: GET /rest/v2/blacklist/domains.

tools.name: woodpecker_list_blacklisted_emails
tools.description: List blacklisted email addresses (never contacted again). Use email_filter to check specific addresses; * is a wildcard. Woodpecker API: GET /rest/v2/blacklist/emails.

tools.name: woodpecker_request_campaign_report
tools.description: Start a per-campaign statistics report for a date range of up to 30 days ending today. Returns a hash: pass it to woodpecker_get_report. Woodpecker API: POST /rest/v2/reports/campaigns.

tools.name: woodpecker_get_report
tools.description: Fetch a report by the hash from woodpecker_request_campaign_report. The status field says READY when data is complete; call again later if it is not. Woodpecker API: GET /rest/v2/reports/{hash}.

tools.name: woodpecker_pause_campaign
tools.description: Pause a running campaign so no more emails go out until it is run again. Reversible by the user in Woodpecker. Repeating the call on a paused campaign is safe. Woodpecker API: POST /rest/v2/campaigns/{id}/pause.

tools.name: woodpecker_add_prospects_to_campaign
tools.description: Add one or more prospects to a campaign's prospect list. A prospect whose account-wide status is not ACTIVE (for example REPLIED or BOUNCED) is not added. The campaign then emails them when it runs. Woodpecker API: POST /rest/v1/add_prospects_campaign.

findings.title: Toxic flow: untrusted input can reach an external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: woodpecker_list_campaigns, woodpecker_search_prospects, woodpecker_list_inbox_messages, woodpecker_get_mailbox, woodpecker_list_blacklisted_emails, woodpecker_add_prospects_to_campaign · Public sink: woodpecker_list_campaigns, woodpecker_search_prospects, woodpecker_get_mailbox, woodpecker_list_blacklisted_emails, woodpecker_request_campaign_report, woodpecker_pause_campaign, woodpecker_add_prospects_to_campaign · Destructive: woodpecker_pause_campaign.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: woodpecker_list_campaigns, woodpecker_search_prospects, woodpecker_list_inbox_messages, woodpecker_get_mailbox, woodpecker_list_blacklisted_emails, woodpecker_add_prospects_to_campaign · Public sink: woodpecker_list_campaigns, woodpecker_search_prospects, woodpecker_get_mailbox, woodpecker_list_blacklisted_emails, woodpecker_request_campaign_report, woodpecker_pause_campaign, woodpecker_add_prospects_to_campaign · Destructive: woodpecker_pause_campaign

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
